messages:
marta.support: Heads up — Client-123 opened an ISO evidence request. They report a slab of missing audit logs around 2026-02-11 13:45–14:30 UTC and several API 401s. They also ask for HSM-backed KMS evidence and key rotation dates. Pasting their short ask below.

marta.support: Customer paste: 'Need logs for 2026-02-11 13:45-14:30 UTC (multiple 401s), proof that keys are HSM-backed, last rotation date, and a signed attestation for auditors. Deadline 2026-03-01.'

jay.sre: Can you share the export id they were given? I can try re-running an export from raw and do a quick grep for 401s. 401s often token expiry or proxy auth flips.

marta.support: Export id: export-CL123-20260211-14. They included a sample trace showing repeated 401s with request_id values. Snippet: ```
2026-02-11T13:58:12Z request_id=abc123 route=/v1/generate status=401 token_id=tok-xyzt
2026-02-11T14:01:03Z request_id=abc456 route=/v1/embed status=401 token_id=tok-xyzt
```

ben.infra: FWIW there's a known edge-case where proxy-1 buffered logs >10m and the batch job dropped late arrivals. Patch landed 2026-02-15. I'll try replaying from raw S3 (raw-audit-bucket) and produce a fresh export including the window.

olivia.security: For KMS/HSM evidence: we can provide key metadata, rotation records, and the vendor-signed attestation PDF (we can't share vendor internal HSM logs per contract). @sam.compliance do you need anything else for the ISO mapping?

sam.compliance: Rotation record shows last rotation 2025-12-10 for key id rwk-client-123. Policy is annual rotation; next scheduled 2026-12-10 per our policy doc. I'll collate rotation CSV + policy excerpt + vendor attestation. Need the key fingerprint and KMS describe output.

ben.infra: Replayed and regenerated export: `redwood-ctl audit export --from 2026-02-11T13:40:00Z --to 2026-02-11T14:40:00Z --filter client=CLIENT-123 --target s3://redwood-audit-evidence/CLIENT-123/ --id export-CL123-20260211-14-replay`
Result: found 42 events, 9 events with status=401. Sample lines: ```
2026-02-11T13:58:12Z request_id=abc123 actor=svc-token-xyz route=/v1/generate response_status=401
2026-02-11T14:01:03Z request_id=abc456 actor=user-789 route=/v1/embed response_status=401
```
I'll attach an md5 and presigned link to the S3 export in the ticket.

marta.support: Thanks — I'll forward to the customer. @olivia.security can you attach the attestation + a `redwood-kms describe` sample output that shows key id, created_at, material origin (HSM), and last_rotated? Customer needs these fields in auditor-friendly format. Also confirm we can provide a signed PDF from the HSM vendor.

olivia.security: :thumbsup: We can provide: (1) vendor attestation PDF (signed), (2) key metadata CSV with columns: key_id, created_at, origin, last_rotated, policy_alias, cert_chain_md5, (3) KMS describe sample. Example command to generate metadata: `redwood-kms describe --key rwk-client-123 --format json` (we'll redact internal IPs). Note: we cannot include vendor internal logs per contract; vendor attestation must suffice.

sam.compliance: Action items: 1) Ben produce replay export link + md5 checksum (ben.infra). 2) Olivia produce attestation PDF + key metadata + KMS describe output (olivia.security). 3) Marta forward to customer and confirm CSV/JSON schema (marta.support). 4) I'll update the ISO-27k mapping doc with evidence references and file ids, then create COMPL ticket. Assigning to ben/olivia/marta.

audit-bot: Ticket COMPL-4321 created by sam.compliance — due 2026-02-28.

marta.support: Customer acked: 'Received export + evidence stub. We'll review and may ask for a small sample of raw events for forensic review.' I'll keep the audit thread posted.

jay.sre: Quick root-cause note for internal: proxy-1 late-buffering -> logs dropped from batch export timeframe. Fix deployed 2026-02-15. Recommend we reprocess affected exports on request. I'll open a follow-up PR with the replay automation.

marta.support: Great, thanks everyone. I'll update the customer and mark COMPL-4321 as in-progress.
